hypothesis: Paired normal-offset distance targets prevent the near-zero field and near-zero gradient collapse observed in the legacy UDF.

variants.legacy_udf: Previous zero-set + normal + Eikonal formulation; failure control.
variants.offset_udf_loss: Unsigned paired offset targets without normal/Eikonal terms.
variants.offset_udf_reg: Unsigned paired offset targets with normal and Eikonal terms.
variants.offset_udf_project_d: offset_udf_reg plus conservative projection only in Stage D.
variants.offset_sdf_loss: Signed paired offset targets without normal/Eikonal terms.
variants.offset_sdf_reg: Signed paired offset targets with normal and Eikonal terms.

robustness_policy: Incomplete test manifests are loaded only after all SDF trainings complete.
